title: What Ambient Computing Fabrics Is
definition: Ambient Computing Fabrics: computation woven invisibly into environments.
description:
Ambient Computing Fabrics: computation woven invisibly into environments. This is Future Software Paradigms at its most ambitious — sensor meshes research, fabric logistics engineering and context inference operations converging on a single goal: making fabric hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Software Paradigms will decide privacy zones outcomes this century. Ambient Computing Fabrics is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working fabric hulls, the larger sensor meshes vision stalls, and with it, the fabric logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Ambient Computing Fabrics in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

t: Real Research Today: Ambient Computing Fabrics
title: Real Research Today: Ambient Computing Fabrics
definition: Today's documented research behind Ambient Computing Fabrics.
description:
The road to Ambient Computing Fabrics is already being paved. WebAssembly brings sandboxed near-native code to every browser and edge device. The seL4 microkernel is the world's first OS kernel with a full formal correctness proof.

Live programming environments (Bret Victor's heritage, Hazel) collapse the edit-compile gap. Together these programs form the sensor meshes foundation that Ambient Computing Fabrics will build on — the fabric logistics results, the context inference methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as fabric logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Ambient Computing Fabrics
definition: Estimates Ambient Computing Fabrics readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Ambient Computing Fabrics components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a fabric hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Ambient Computing Fabrics Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Ambient Computing Fabrics operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Ambient Computing Fabrics installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 44837 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where sensor meshes monitoring, fabric logistics redundancy, or context inference maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Ambient Computing Fabrics Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Ambient Computing Fabrics: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Ambient Computing Fabrics — computation woven invisibly into environments.

Phase 1 — Prove (sensor meshes): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (fabric logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (context inference): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (privacy zones): fabric hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and smart spaces-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
